criticism.en: One of the most common criticisms of British food is that it is bland .
criticism.zh: 对英国食物最常见的批评之一是它很平淡。

criticism.en: One of the big criticisms of nuclear power, historically at least, is that it is expensive.
criticism.zh: 历史上对核电的一大诟病，至少从过去来看，就是它太贵了。

criticism.en: It hasn't been tested. And there are some criticisms of the videos because they involve filming your interactions with strangers, which people might not want.
criticism.zh: 它尚未经过科学验证。而且这些视频也受到了一些批评，因为拍摄涉及与陌生人的互动，而对方可能并不希望被拍。

critic.en: Critics point out that decisions made about something as safety-critical as nuclear power are increasingly being made by companies whose main interest is keeping their data centres running, not public accountability .
critic.zh: 批评人士指出，像核电这样攸关安全的重大决策，正日益由那些主要利益是维持数据中心运行、而非对公众负责的公司来制定。

create.en: It was created through migration and has become part of British food culture.
create.zh: 它是通过移民创造的，并已成为英国饮食文化的一部分。

create.en: When you don’t have much meat, butter, eggs, sugar, you don’t really have opportunities to create tasty dishes.
create.zh: 当你没有多少肉、黄油、鸡蛋、糖时，你真的没有机会创造美味的菜肴。

criticize.en: But the food of ordinary people continued to be based on local ingredients and traditional recipes By the 18th century, some British writers were already complaining about this trend, criticizing wealthy British people who preferred French cooks to English ones.
criticize.zh: 但普通人的食物继续以本地食材和传统食谱为基础。到了18世纪，一些英国作家已经开始抱怨这种趋势，批评那些宁愿要法国厨师也不要英国厨师的富有英国人。

cross.en: Britain depended on imported food at the time, but German submarines threatened all the ships crossing the Atlantic.
cross.zh: 当时英国依赖进口食物，但德国潜艇威胁了所有穿过大西洋的船只。
